chapters.title: While you sleep: the airway
chapters.caption_text: The airway can become very narrow, and it is hard to get air through. With the jaw further forward, the airway is more open. This can get rid of snoring and obstructive sleep apnea. So how far should the jaw be moved forward? Too far forward, and it’s uncomfortable. Not far enough, and the airway does not open. Open airway, still comfortable.

chapters.title: APS Airway Bite
chapters.caption_text: APS Airway Bite — Chairside workflow for a mandibular advancement bite
chapters.notes: Title card text (no caption bar). Dip-to-black transition 22.83-23.33; clean from 23.33. Kit packet shown.

chapters.title: What's in the kit
chapters.caption_text: One single-use packet: the airway bite, a pencil and a card ruler. Nothing to sterilize. The bite seats over the upper central incisors. Its 4 mm stop sits under the incisal edges.

captions.text: One single-use packet: the airway bite, a pencil and a card ruler. Nothing to sterilize.
The bite seats over the upper central incisors. Its 4 mm stop sits under the incisal edges.

chapters.notes: Caption bar has no header line in this section. Close-up of the device from ~42.6 s (stills/kit-device.webp).

chapters.title: Before you start
chapters.caption_text: Before you start: digital scan of the upper and lower arches, without a bite.

captions.label: BEFORE YOU START
captions.text: Before you start: digital scan of the upper and lower arches, without a bite.

chapters.title: Try-in
chapters.caption_text: Seat the airway bite over the upper central incisors. Shift it back for a Class II bite, forward for a Class III bite. Note the orientation.

captions.label: STEP 1  TRY-IN
captions.text: Seat the airway bite over the upper central incisors.

captions.label: STEP 1  TRY-IN
captions.text: Shift it back for a Class II bite, forward for a Class III bite. Note the orientation.

chapters.title: Reline
chapters.caption_text: Fill with fast-set silicone (Parkell Blu-Mousse) and reseat. Reline again if needed.

captions.label: STEP 2  RELINE
captions.text: Fill with fast-set silicone (Parkell Blu-Mousse) and reseat. Reline again if needed.

chapters.title: Mark the range
chapters.caption_text: With the bite on the upper teeth, slide the jaw fully back. Pencil-mark the lower incisor edge. Now fully forward: mark again, and mark the midline on both lines.

captions.label: STEP 3  MARK THE RANGE
captions.text: With the bite on the upper teeth, slide the jaw fully back. Pencil-mark the lower incisor edge.

captions.label: STEP 3  MARK THE RANGE
captions.text: Now fully forward: mark again, and mark the midline on both lines.

chapters.title: Measure
chapters.caption_text: Remove the bite and measure the total front-to-back movement. Typically 10-12 mm.

captions.label: STEP 4  MEASURE
captions.text: Remove the bite and measure the total front-to-back movement. Typically 10-12 mm.

chapters.title: Target
chapters.caption_text: Mark the target halfway between the two lines. 40-50% of the range is a common start.

captions.label: STEP 5  TARGET
captions.text: Mark the target halfway between the two lines. 40-50% of the range is a common start.

chapters.title: Tap into position
chapters.caption_text: Reseat the bite. Have the patient tap repeatedly while you guide the jaw to the target mark.

captions.label: STEP 6  TAP INTO POSITION
captions.text: Reseat the bite. Have the patient tap repeatedly while you guide the jaw to the target mark.

chapters.title: Lock the position
chapters.caption_text: Flow composite on the bite in front of and behind the lower incisors. Light-cure. The jaw is now held steady in the forward position.

captions.label: STEP 7  LOCK THE POSITION
captions.text: Flow composite on the bite in front of and behind the lower incisors.

captions.label: STEP 7  LOCK THE POSITION
captions.text: Light-cure. The jaw is now held steady in the forward position.

chapters.title: Bite scan
chapters.caption_text: Scan the bite with the jaw held forward and send it to the lab.

captions.label: STEP 8  BITE SCAN
captions.text: Scan the bite with the jaw held forward and send it to the lab.

chapters.title: Done
chapters.caption_text: One single-use packet. Nothing to sterilize.
